notes.title: Post Human W.A.R. Post Release Patch #1
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/63dae1d356e35c9b15b8c8dd5143a4b9e02a80ad.jpg

Hear ye, friends of Post Human W.A.R!

It's been eight weeks already since the release of Post Human W.A.R, and many battles have taken place! New ways of taking advantage of our game mechanics have been found and spread! Losing battles have been won! Some rookies have risen to the top of the rankings, and many have completed the campaigns!

Today we're launching the first post-release update. This is kind of an important update, with two major novelties:

    The ability to create games with 3 or 4 players, online or offline. You can compete in teams or in a free-for-all. And if you're a local co-op aficionado you can also challenge the AI! And to celebrate, three new maps will allow you to have 4 players.
    Also, the introduction of Post Human W.A.R Steam Cards! You asked for them, it is now done.

We hope you enjoy these new features! May the strategy be with you.

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Final Patch Note 21 - ONE LAST TIME, WITH FEELING
notes.content:
Hi there, fellow strategists!

Okay, here we are, the final update! Next week, Post Human W.A.R will be out of its early access, meaning that all the missions of the campaign mode will be available... but we'll talk about it next week :-)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

So for this final Patch Note, we're glad to announce that we have implemented the daily challenges! It's gonna be Groundhog Day everyday, but with a twist - every day will have a new challenge - and Postcoins for those who succeed. You'll be able to purchase a lot of avatars and units skins with the Postcoins, so be sure to come back everyday! Oh, and you'll also be able to unlock new Pourparlers (you know, these nice and friendly emojis you can send to your opponent).
Second and last point, we made some balancing in a few campaign mode battles. We don't want you to be frustrated in one way or another, especially if you are a sore loser.

WHEW, I guess we're done for the Post Human W.A.R Patch Notes. I'm pretty sure you'll miss these almost-weekly updates, but the true adventure begins now for us. Help us spread the word about Post Human W.A.R release, and how our game is a must-have for all turn-based strategy fans! And if you wanna hear some good dev stories or just talk about the game, make sure to join us on our Discord thread! 


See you on the other side, my friends!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/63dae1d356e35c9b15b8c8dd5143a4b9e02a80ad.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 20
notes.content:
Hi there, high perforance aspirants!

Here's Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #20. We're pretty much done with all the work we wanted to do on Post Human W.A.R. Full release is drawing near, and you'll have some good news about it next week! So EXCITING!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 19
notes.content:
Hi there, fashion enthusiasts! Post Human W.A.R is back again, and this time we brought a whole WARDROBE in our luggages. Here's the Patch Note #19!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png


    We enabled the long awaited Preset Composition feature: now you an predefine your troops, far from the heat of battle, and then load them instantly in local and online skirmishes!
    In the same fashion, You can also personalize your units, give them fancy names and...
    ... Their SKIN. Every units as now several skins for you to choose from. New skins will be added on a regular basis. They can be bought in the shop. Don't worry, no such thing as buying it with real money, Post Human W.A.R isn't the "Game as a service" type :-)


That's it for today. If you think Post Human W.A.R should change its economic model, let us know! (SPOILER: [spoiler]WE WON'T[/spoiler])

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/dbc8f12d3909258e768dfd5002f70106de9859be.gif

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 18
notes.content:
He who craves outsmarting moves, may he be welcome!

Here's another Patch Note for Post Human W.A.R. We are currently in our final stretch, and the full release is pretty close. We'll be sure to give you informations about it pretty soon. But for now, here we go for the Patch Note #18!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

You feel an excruciating pain each time you have to wait for the AI to play? Let's end the suffuring: Now you can speed up its move!
IDENTIFY YOURSELF!... Nah, just kiddin'. If you play offline, there's no need to log in anymore. All your progress in campaign mode is now saved on your computer and on Steam Cloud.
We sharpened the AI skills. Watch out for long range units. Just sayin'.

That's it for today. Stay tuned, because as we say: THE END IS NEAR (in a very optimistic way)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/bca7a4f4121220cfa9b1cd71270a3ce998d90fcc.jpg

notes.content:

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 16
notes.content:
- Hey, Mike. Wake up Mike. Mike! MIKE WAKE UP FOR F*CK SAKE!
- Ralph? W-W-W-What's going on? It's like 2 in the morning! And how did you get in my house? Ugh, forget it. I gotta sleep, got a lot of things to do tomorrow!
- OH PLEASE! I know Saturday is laundry day for you... You'll also grab a few expired food at the grocery store - yes, I know you buy expired food because you're POOR - and send a pathetic text message to your pathetic ex-girlfriend, just to tell her how miserable your life is now, but she'll probably ignore it because she's too busy GETTIN' LAI--
- OK, OK, I GET IT. You don't need to be so rude... So what do you want ?
- What do I want? What do I want? I want to show you this beauty. It's a time travelling machine called Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 16!
- ... Post Human what? I'm sure I'm gonna regret it but... What is it?

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- Okay, listen up Mike. This is no ordinary time travelling machine. With this one, you can now record every game you played in Post Human W.A.R - training mode, local versus, online, or whatever.
- Yeah, okay. Time travelling machine. Cool. Can you leave now?
- That's not all, you dumb*ss. With this machine, you can also watch your previous games, and skip the waiting time of all actions. You can even skip directly to the turn you wish to watch, if you have something particular in mind! 
- That's... yeah that's great Ralph, really. Okay, well, thanks for showin--
- NOT. DONE. YET.
- Jeez...
- Let's say you have a friend. Yeah I know, pretty unrealistic because except me, you have no friend.
- Right now, you're more like a bed intruder than a friend to me.
- LET ME FINISH. So, this hypothetical friend do not believe you when you say you have accomplished a wonderful action. Well, now, you can export your game and share it to your him. Or even the world. Or EVEN THE UNIVERSE. Can you believe it? The U.N.I.V.E.R.S.E.
- I don't think the universe cares about it, but ok, that's good to know. Anything else?
- OF COURSE THERE IS. Just to let you know, now when your unit stands on a healing zone, it will restore 10hp. BUT If your totem is destroyed, you'll lose 15hp every turn. So there's no hiding forever!
- ...
- ONE LAST THING: the AI now make a better use of AOE damages. You have been warned!
- Hmm okay, but I have a question... What do these last features have anything to do with your time travelling thingy?
- THAT'S THE POINT. ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. THIS IS WHY I'M A GENIUS, THE KIND OF GUY WHO CAN MIX THINGS TO MAKE THEM BETTER!!!
- I... Okay that's it, get outta my house.
- I Will, but promise me that you'll try the Time Travelling Machine. It's cool, and it can turn your pitiful life into... well... something less pitiful I guess.
- Yeah okay, I will definitely play Post Human W.A.R and try these features, so now GET OUT!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/57e6a361bccea850a83bec5ed8c61ba2d59305d8.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 15
notes.content:
Hello There, I'm Doctor Soy Spinachsauce, specialized in mood disorder. Autumn has fallen, and you probably feel a little down, bland, weak... Well, this common trouble is called Seasonal Affective Disorder. Rest assured, I got you covered: Here's a prescription to make you feel better, The Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 15!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

    To increase your appetite, I upgraded the map in conquest mode with new graphics and a revamped level design with more obstacles. It will be easier for long ranged units to hide and harass opponents!
    To improve your overall skin complexion, Champion Reveal and Units Recycle features are now added to the tutorial syrup. You won't miss anything about those unique elements, never seen before in any other Turn-Based Strategy Game (I think...)   
    Your lack of energy is another symptom... to counter this, here's a "recycle when you want" shot. Now you can recycle your units even after they moved or acted! Whoops, I missed your vein. Let me do it again. Sorry about this.
    Lastly, I'm pretty sure your libido just collapsed. Here take these pills : 4 new maps for the conquest mode to boost your intimate relationship. No, don't thank me. What? You're single? Well, I'm afraid I have no remedy for that!!! Hahaha! ... Haha...Ha... ...

Well, that's it for this Patch Note 15! If you like the game, if you have Seasonal Affective Disorder, or if you have a cat,  just share our Discord Thread  and let the world now about Post Human W.A.R!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/2df25a46184661fee81ef4fca056ca2a615f5de6.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 14
notes.content:
Hey there, adventurers. Sharpen your shovels and draw your pick axe - the time has come to get stinkin' rich. Follow the Gold Digger Guide, aka Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #14!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png


    Finding gold can be really exhausting, so try to limit your resources consumption! And if you think you can recycle your units as much as you can to grab resources, then you're WRONG. You can still do it, but only once per turn!
    Have you tried the Gold Digging Simulator? Well, just choose the Practice Mode! You can now define how many resources points your AI controlled opponent will start with!
    We have refined a few display windows. Now the GAME sparkles like a highly polished GEM.


Okay guys. This is just the beginning of your journey, and we'll be friends and competitors at the same time. In any case, I wish you all the best of luck, and see you for the next Patch Note!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/71b40f6203a3c18880069a563727bd723030067c.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 13
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow strategists!

We're back for a new Patch Note in a more standard shape. No fancy name, no movie acting, no stroll in the zoo. It's good to enjoy simple things from time to time. So, what's up with this Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #13?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png


From now on, You can save ANY battles in campaign and training mode, quit the game and come back later at your saving point. And that's because YOU demanded it!
We improved fonts displaying so that every language can have bold, italic and all. We're not into politics, but we want equality for everyone!
Finally, We resolved some click issues when exploring the codex, preventing the correct informations from displaying.


That's it for this Patch Note! Hope you enjoy the game, feel free to talk about it and if you have any suggestion,  just join our Discord . We're here 24/7 to talk about it. Well, not really "24/7", more like "18/6" but...

Anyway, feel free to come!

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 13
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow strategists!

We're back for a new Patch Note in a more standard shape. No fancy name, no movie acting, no stroll in the zoo. It's good to enjoy simple things from time to time. So, what's up with this Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #13?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png


From now on, You can save ANY battles in campaign and training mode, quit the game and come back later at your saving point. And that's because YOU demanded it!
We improved fonts displaying so that every language can have bold, italic and all. We're not into politics, but we want equality for everyone!
Finally, We resolved some click issues when exploring the codex, preventing the correct informations from displaying.


That's it for this Patch Note! Hope you enjoy the game, feel free to talk about it and if you have any suggestion,  just join our Discord . We're here 24/7 to talk about it. Well, not really "24/7", more like "18/6" but...

Anyway, feel free to come!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/8070f622242a9bc52ab0c4dce5aa5a018b6e3873.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 12
notes.content:
Alright Ladies and Gentlemen. For those who don't know me, I'm Post Human W.A.R film director, and we're here to shoot Patch Note #12. I expect everybody to do their best.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

Quick recap of the situation: Squad leader F3L-X is at the R-Patch base camp. Several of its subordinates rush around him.

Patch Note #12, take 1, aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaand... ACTION!

- F3L-X! F3L-X!
- Calm down. What's the fuss 'bout?
- A small Wraak squad has been spotted. They brought some change: AoE damage dealing units can now boost their attack power, without using more resources than other units.
- ... And does it work for Anthropists and R-Patch too?
- Yes, it does...
- Well, that's good news. It just means that it will be even more easier to crush them!

- F3L-X! F3L-XXXXXX!
- What now?
- The camera! The camera! It automatically zooms on a Champion's death, the screen shakes in case of powerful attacks... It's going crazy!
- It's called "visual feedback", you idiot. Now stop panicking over nothing and get back to your position!

- Sir F3L-X! OMG Sir F3L-X!
- ... You gotta be kiddin' me...
- The loading is faster than before, especially before cutscenes! 
- ... And ?
- ... Well... we won't have time to relax before battles anymore, it's going super fast!
- WE ARE AT WAR, THERE'S NO TIME TO RELAX!
- But Sir-
- GIT OUTTA HERE!!!

- Hmmm... F3L-X?
- Yes dear?
- You seem a little tensed. But I have some good news for you!
- Which is?
- The IA has been upgraded. Now the IA controlled units can boost their movement if they judge it necessary. You're going to have a hard time defeating them! Isn't it wonderful?
- ... Yeah... truly wonderful...

CUT!

Ok, that was PERFECT guys. We can skip to the other scene right now!

See you soon for the next Patch Note!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/30c8434351b542197f3354cd4aff9ca735bfcb98.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 11
notes.content:
“Hello fellow R-PATCH and Welcome to our Wraaks and Anthropists Zoo.

Please take a stroll among our different parks and have a great day visiting the Wraaks and Anthropists Zoo.”

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- Daddy Daddy, I wanna go see the Sumogoris and Arrowgutans at the Anthropist area! I heard they can talk and have a weird sens of humour.
- Fine fine. We’ll go there first. But don’t take too long if you wanna see the Bipolar bear show with the penguins” 
- Yeah, got it Dad. Hey what’s that paper stuck in the fence? 
- Seems like a note. Let’s see what it says: “ The IA has been adapted for the new gameplay rule. It will protect its own champion, know how to use the reveal mechanism and hunt your champion unit down if you happen to reveal it.” 
- What does it mean Daddy? 
- Well haven’t you heard me? The AI has been remade according to the last patch note that changed everything in Post Human WAR! 
- I don’t get it… Laaaaaame! OH its time for the Bipolar show. Where is the arena Dad? Where is it?
- Just a sec… This way… on the right after the Arms-Adillos and the Ambivarans. 

- Wow! Have you seen that Daddy? The penguin went so high up… like 3km high!!  Oh it seems like the penguin dropped something in the air. It’s coming our way. CATCH IT DAD CATCHIT!
- Got it! Ha, just a ball of trash. 
- Wait there is something written on it. READ IT!!
- “The camera focus on the opposing units is now more fluid when they play. Also, some adjustments to better guide the players and some bugs fixes.” 
- Gibberish again!
- Come on… its great news! The menu is clearer and bug free now!
- Yay…
- Come on! Let’s go see the Fakeer to Peers and the Hitchimp on the way back to the car. It’s getting late.

“Thank you for visiting the Wraaks and Anthropists Zoo and remember: Wraaks and Anthropists may look cute, but would kill you if they have the chance. Thank Lord for our R-PATCH troops for defeating them on the battlefield.”
We hope to see you again soon at the Wraaks Zoo!”

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/05e7692e9a7a98a18a599b01465423678da4af2b.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 9
notes.content:
Hello there, dear worshipers of strategy games,

Here we go again with some new patches on Post Human W.A.R... Well, the Title is "Patch Note #9" after all, what did you expect?

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 8
notes.content:
Ok guys, zombies are roaming everywhere in this area. We need to proceed with caution if we don't want to get bitten. Let's take a look at the survival note, A.K.A Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #8!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- When you move, try to be as quiet as possible. In other words, when it's your turn to play in online conquest mode, you can't use the chat function anymore.
- One of our men previously scouted the area, losing his life in the process ("R.I.P in peace", as we say). Anyway, there's no missing bitmaps anymore.
- The foes around here aren't the typical bunch of zombies, their moves are smoother than before... yeah, we have fixed a few bugs impacting some units animations.

That's all for the Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #8. Stay safe, and remember: "When Zombies are swarmin', protect ya brain".

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/879746b83424e968a71bd29c8bea020cf5316b29.jpg

notes.title: Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 7
notes.content:
Hey rookies. I'm the Detective in charge.

So, we got a situation here: a triple homicide. Probably a first-degree murder, since the perpetrator left a Note. He even gave it a name! What kind of twisted mind could came up with the name "Post Human W.A.R Patch Note 7" ?!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

Anyway,	here's what it says.

"- I added 3 new tunes in online mode. One for each of my victims. They danced, and danced and danced... 'till they dropped dead!
- The loading bar issue on the splash screen and after Army Composition is now fixed. Oh boy, did I enjoy looking at them watching the loading bar reaching the complete status... 
- In case of brief lost of connections, the automatic client reconnection is now enabled. I suffocated them and let them breath again and again. What a thrill!"

... Well, this guy has a sick sense of humor. We can't let this murderer at large. If you have any hint or suggestion, I want all units to talk about it on our   Discord Thread .

That's all. Let's get our hand on this Post Human W.A.R!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/2eefd5dc5c880790cc801caceeff0d74cb10b3ca.jpg

notes.title: Patch Note #6
notes.content:
* Knock knock knock *. As you head towards your door, you can see that a piece of paper has been slipped under it. You unfold this paper enthusiastically... Holy moly! It's Post Human W.A.R Patch Note #6! So what does it say?

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- You don't want to play in campaign mode while waiting for an online battle? Well, you can now watch another online game before yours begin. In addition to that, the "Quick Contest" and "Classic Contest" searches have been merged together. It basically means that you can do whatever you want while searching for a online game!
- The main menu music has been revamped. Sounds even more delightful than ever!
- For our Russian players: Few bugs correction of the textual display

Satisfied, you put the piece of paper on your chest and breath deeply. "I can't wait for the next Patch Note", you whisper. Well, it's coming next week.

Take care!

notes.title: Patch Note #4
notes.content:
Oh! Post Human W.A.R Fans! Fancy meeting you here!

Well, we're almost halfway before the final release. We brought some heavy stuff for the occasion, so it's time to get pumped up!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- The first 3 missions of the Anthropist campaign has been added. The great exile of this faction has begun, and its survival relies on your wits!
- You have better things to do than watching the search screen when looking for a battle in Conquest Mode? Now you can navigate through the menu or play in campaign mode while the search is ongoing. As soon as you find a competitor online, you'll go into the fight with him. "What about my solo campaign battle", you ask? Well, it has been saved! Once the Conquest Mode confrontation is over, you'll be back to your solo campaign battle. Isn't it convenient? Of course it is!

We also got news for the Beta players:

- First of all, we added 3 missions of the Wraak Campaign. We thought that it's a good thing to let you discover the story of Post Human W.A.R a little more. Aren't we generous?
- Also, we decided to let the Beta last for one more month. Tell the world about our game!

We're done for today Patch Note! As a reminder,   you can still join our Discord here 

See you next week!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/fe297ac25cc198c87fd2709486304ae2273ceac1.jpg

notes.title: Patch Note #2
notes.content:
Hello, dear strategists!

Here's the second patch note, so keep your eyes peeled!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- You don't give a damn about the Human legacy? Well, rejoice, because the first 3 missions of the Wraak faction have been added!
-  Vous aime le France ? I bet you do. The French voices have been implemented to the R-Patch video introduction. Bravo! 
- Some matchmaking tweeks: in Conquest Mode, when 2 players are looking for a game with different resource points set, they might be put together - based on the lowest one - to speed up game search.

And among other stuff:
- A fullscreen / windowed mode button on the splash screen
- New visuals in the campaign mode menu
- Lastly, we have corrected a few bugs. This is Early Access after all.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/ef94dbf483f4cf50cd0e4fc13b047da850de956b.jpg

That's all folks. Don't hesitate to share your feedback if you like Post Human W.A.R (or not).

Le bisou.

notes.title: Patch Note #1
notes.content:
Hi there, fellow Post Human W.A.Rriors. 

Here we are, the first Early Access Update. Yaaaay!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/eafacc7a68a3c207b95100d0c5c88a37b014cd2e.png

- First of all, our game is getting a little more international, since we added 2 new languages : Russian and Spanish. Did I hear a "Harasho"? Or was that a "Fantástico"?
- We also heard that numerous players got their asses handed to them in the mission 2 of the R-Patch Campaign. We lowered the difficulty (a little bit).
- Some server issues have been detected. The scum has been eliminated and you should be able to reconnect to your battle without losing the game now.
- Cleaned out a few bugs (AI being stuck in campaign mode, spectator mode...)

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28043186/20b97db855f6128e329a7d986b86a3bdf10c3720.jpg

And that's it for today. Talk to you next week.

Class Dismissed!
